reason: The README describes a plugin that routes dsh through the Agnes AI API and registers dsh as a Paseo ACP provider, including local credential storage, configuration changes, and process bridging.

summaries.zh: 将 dsh 接入 Agnes AI 模型网关，并通过 ACP 桥将其注册为 Paseo provider。
summaries.en: Connects dsh to the Agnes AI model gateway and registers it as a Paseo provider through an ACP bridge.

capabilities: Connects dsh to the Agnes AI OpenAI-compatible API gateway
Registers dsh as a Paseo ACP provider
Stores an Agnes API key in a local credentials file
Writes Paseo provider configuration and creates a backup
Spawns dsh in headless mode through an ACP bridge
